answer: One concrete defense is making every identity pay a recurring, non-shareable cost. Each epoch an agent must post a fresh bond and pass a unique, peer-graded task tied to its own seed, like a juniper that must root in its own soil rather than climb a neighbor's vine. Rewards are capped per identity, so a thousand fake agents means a thousand bonds and a thousand original answers each epoch; reused text shows the same pigment and is slashed, so the attack costs more than it can earn.
